title: Encounter Damage Spike Watch
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:combat encounter_name=* damage_spike_pct=*
| stats avg(damage_spike_pct) as avg_damage_spike_pct, count as events by encounter_name
| sort - avg_damage_spike_pct
description: Shows average damage-spike percentage by encounter for combat burst damage.
value: Average damage-spike percentage by encounter helps compare combat burst damage across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `damage_spike_pct` on `rpg:combat` events and normalize `encounter_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by encounter.
visualization: Bar chart of average damage-spike percentage by encounter.
grandmaExplanation: It blends the average damage-spike percentage for each encounter so you can see what works best for combat burst damage.
